subject: 藏地跨年代地域素材：小型平顶碉房（原创扩展；具体城市年代适用待考）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit THIS reference guardhouse into a one-storey small Tibetan home. LOCK AND PRESERVE THIS REFERENCE'S NEAR-SQUARE GROUND PLAN AND CAMERA EXACTLY. Do not elongate any side. Existing plan is 6m frontage by5m depth; both visible wall widths nearly equal, ratio1.2. Remove the upper storey, lower the flat roof vertically to one-storey height. Keep the footprint wall corners where they are; same roof plan shape, same stone walls, same amount of short side wall visible, same orthographic 2:1 camera, same upper-left light. Replace awning entry with plain wood door, keep two small ground-floor windows. Remove external paving/vegetation; wall foot is clear, no protruding slab. Keep muted white weathered stone, dark red lintels and dark wood, unadorned flat earthen roof and low parapet. Render exactly one complete building with fully OPAQUE alpha255 interior and crisp silhouette on fully transparent alpha0 background, no semitransparent haze or halo, no shadow glow. Generous transparent margins. No people, text, symbols, modern things. The near-square footprint is the PRIMARY invariant; do not make a long facade.
negative: 无文字/现代物/人物/景观背景/厚地台；不拉伸、旋转、重绘或抠白底
created_time_basis: 工具PNG本地mtime，非服务端生成时间

geometry_qa.anchor_method: 人工可见墙脚L/F/R，后角按平行边推算；底面中心=(L+R)/2。非alpha底中点。

steps: alpha>1 determines bounding rectangle only; preserved all pixels inside rectangle
uniform LANCZOS resize with integer pixel rounding
paste without alpha mask onto transparent canvas; no repaint or warp

notes: 合入前审核返修：本轮2候选选第2；旧候选留档。原图及成品已view_image；仅裁切、等比缩放、透明扩边。占地未改，底角重新量取，实测残差见geometry_qa；不宣称全部几何通过，维持candidate。
